build_colorwheel: build a color wheel for optical flow visualization using the Middlebury standard
create_flow_color_image: create a color image from horizontal and vertical flow components u and v
convert_flow_to_color: convert a 2D flow array of shape H,W,2 to a color-coded RGB image
